title: AI-augmented analytics engineering at DocuSign: dbt v2, dbt MCP, and agent skills
description:
How DocuSign cut analytics engineering time in half by pairing Claude Code with dbt v2, the dbt MCP server, and dbt agent skills. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Bishal Gupta of DocuSign shares how far his team pushed AI into analytics engineering without giving up review. SQL generation was never the bottleneck; context switching between a Jira requirement, unwritten dbt conventions, and reporting needs was. Splitting the workflow into discovery, dbt development, and orchestration phases means a failed compile or skipped test retries on its own. The pilot delivered a 50% productivity gain from requirement to a validated, review-ready dbt asset, with human review still required.

In this session you'll learn:
• How a three-phase agent workflow runs from requirement to pull request
• How dbt agent skills and the MCP server supply conventions and context
• Where human review stays in the loop

Speaker: Bishal Gupta, DocuSign

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai
